articles.title: Gayle King to Step Away From ‘CBS Mornings’ After Son-in-Law’s Death at 45
articles.summary: Gayle King will step away from "CBS Mornings" following the death of her son-in-law Virgil Miller to cancer.
articles.body:
Gayle King will step away from "CBS Mornings" following the death of her son-in-law Virgil Miller to cancer.

"Mornings Family – I'm sorry to be delivering this sad news," "CBS Mornings" executive producer Jon Tower said in a memo to staff. He continued saying that "over the Thanksgiving holiday" Virgil lost his life after a "courageous battle with cancer."

Tower added: "Our thoughts right now are with her daughter, and their two beautiful children. We're respecting the family and giving them privacy as they get through this difficult time."

The memo added that King planned to step away from the show for the next week to "help with family matters." She plans to return to the show beginning on Dec. 7.

Miller married King's daughter Kirby Bumpus back in December 2020. The couple wed at Bumpus' godmother Oprah Winfrey's home. Miller is survived by his wife and their two children, son Luca, 5, and daughter Grayson, 2.

Miller spent 10 years as chief of staff for former U.S. Rep. Cedric Richmond on Capitol Hill in Washington D.C. and in 2019 moved on to join the Akin Gump law firm to serve as a senior policy advisor.

King praised her late son-in-law often on social media. Back in 2022, in a post both about Miller's birthday and his and Bumpus' son's birthday, she called him "my fav son-in-law" and a "great husband to fav daughter @kirbybump & best dad to fav grandson."

articles.title: Irish comedian and actor PJ Gallagher passes away at 51: 'Ireland has lost one of its most cherished entertainers'
articles.summary: Comedian PJ Gallagher passed away at the age of 51. According to reports, he was found in his home in the north side of Dublin.
articles.body: Comedian PJ Gallagher passed away at the age of 51. According to reports, he was found in his home in the north side of Dublin. Emergency services were called to the premises, but despite the efforts, the radio star could not be revived.PJ Gallagher passes away at 51The news abuot his demse was shared by his management agency in an official statement to The Irish Sun. The statement read, "It is with enormous sadness that we confirm the death of PJ Gallagher. PJ was a much-loved comedian, actor, writer, and broadcaster. He had a wonderfully particular way of looking at the world and an extraordinary ability to make people laugh, whether on stage, on television, or in the company of his listeners each morning.”The statement by the family also asked fans and netizens for some privacy as they cope with the loss. At the time of writing, the cause of his demise was not made public.Tributes pour in for PJ GallagherMany people from the industry, along with fans and netizens, shared their condolences and tributes online. Taoiseach (the Prime Minister of the Republic of Ireland) Micheál Martin also issued a statement following the news of his passing. Taking to his X (formerly known as Twitter) account, he called Gallagher a "gifted comedian, actor, and broadcaster; he brought immense warmth and laughter to so many across Ireland." He continued, “My heartfelt sympathies to his family, friends, and colleagues at this very difficult time."Tánaiste (the Deputy Prime Minister of the Republic of Ireland) Simon Harris also shared his thoughts for the comedian and wrote in a post, "Ireland has lost one of its most cherished entertainers. PJ had that rare and wonderful ability to make people feel as though they knew him personally.”Who was PJ Gallagher?PJ Gallagher was an Irish stand-up comedian, actor, radio presenter, and mental health advocate. Born on April 18, 1975, he had been working in the entertainment industry for years and was an established comedian, actor, and radio show host.Over the course of his career, Starred in sketch shows like 'Meet Your Neighbours' and 'Makin' Jake', performed stand-up on Irish comedy circuits and festivals, and appeared in 'Uncharted with Ray Goggins' and 'The Random Driving Test.' . He also co-presented the 'Dubland' podcast with Suzanne Kane.Since 2021, Gallagher has hosted Radio Nova’s breakfast program called 'Morning Glory.' The radio channel's Instagram account also shared a tribute for the beloved entertainer and wrote, "PJ Gallagher will be so dearly missed by all who had the privilege to cross his path.
